## Services
- [Permanent placement](https://www.lifelineplacements.com/services/permanent-placement/): We source, screen and shortlist. The person joins your payroll and you pay us once.
- [Contract staffing](https://www.lifelineplacements.com/services/contract-staffing/): Workers stay on our payroll. We pay wages, PF and ESI, bill you monthly and replace people who leave.
- [Bulk hiring](https://www.lifelineplacements.com/services/bulk-hiring/): Many similar roles to one start date: new lines, new processes, festive peaks.
- [Payroll outsourcing](https://www.lifelineplacements.com/services/payroll-outsourcing/): You choose the people. We hold them on our rolls and run salary, PF, ESI and filings.
